subject: drama
topicName: Boal and Theatre of the Oppressed

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Forum theatre: a play is performed, then replayed with audience members ('spect-actors') stepping in to change the outcome — the audience becomes active.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Spect-actor: the audience member who stops the action and replaces a character — they are both spectator and actor.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Image theatre: participants use their bodies to create still images (sculptures) of oppression — reveals issues without words.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Invisible theatre: performed in public spaces without the audience knowing it's theatre — provokes real reactions and discussion.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: The 'Joker' is NOT a clown — it's a facilitator role, always explain this Boal's work is about EMPOWERMENT — always link to giving the audience agency Forum theatre requires the 'stop' mechanism — describe the full process Boal questions often ask you to compare with Brecht — know the similarities and differences
